_comment: Shape of a Power Platform DLP policy for the ticket agent's lab environment. Business group: the ticket custom connector and the MCP connector it rides on; Blocked: the HTTP virtual connector except an APIM allow-list and 'Chat without Microsoft Entra ID authentication'. Admin API: PUT https://api.bap.microsoft.com/providers/PowerPlatform.Governance/v2/policies/{policyId}?api-version=2016-11-01 (# verify path and version against the DLP admin API page, F1). Shape derived from PowerShell New-DlpPolicy output; field names marked verify.

connectors.name: Chat without Microsoft Entra ID authentication in Copilot Studio
